final_wiki.answer-Q-1995-X8E:
Q-1995: What day of the week was 2022-03-05?

Answer: Saturday

Explanation: January 1, 2022 was a Saturday. March 5 is 63 days after January 1 (31 days in January + 28 days in February + 4 days to reach March 5 from March 1). 63 is divisible by 7, so March 5, 2022 fell on the same day of the week as January 1 — Saturday.
